public_source.title: The Nordstrom-Robinson Code is the Binary Image of the Octacode
public_source.formula_evidence: The paper identifies the Nordstrom-Robinson code as the octacode's Gray image and gives its minimum distance as 6.
public_source.parameter_transfer: Append one zero coordinate to the (16,256,6) Nordstrom-Robinson code; this preserves every pairwise distance and gives a (17,256,6) code.

verification.method: Enumerated all 4^4 octacode messages from the published Z4 generator matrix, applied the published Gray map, appended one zero coordinate, and checked all pairs with the exact T067 validator.

source.paper_title: A new two-error-correcting binary code of length 16
source.author: Moshe Milshtein
source.evidence: Brouwer attributes A(17,6) >= 258 to Milshtein. His paper abstract reports a (16,258,5) construction; appending an overall parity bit gives a (17,258,6) construction.

access_checks.result: Only the abstract and first-page preview were exposed; the codeword table was unavailable.

limitations: No 258-word codeword list has been obtained or independently verified, so the 258 lower bound is recorded as reported rather than reproduced.
The reproduced 256-word witness is below the highest reported value of 258; it is not marked as matching the best public result.
Milshtein's 258-word witness remains unavailable in the public sources checked, so the benchmark has no verified 258-word artifact yet.
